content.subject: Personio's data pipelines under 9.6% growth
content.opening_hook: With your team in Berlin managing data pipelines for 15,000+ SMB customers across 6 countries and headcount up 9.6% in the last 12 months, the pressure on your AWS and PostgreSQL infrastructure to hold freshness SLAs without creeping warehouse costs is a real constraint — especially in a consolidation phase where every euro of infrastructure spend is under scrutiny.
content.value_prop: We help SaaS platforms at your scale reduce pipeline toil and keep data costs flat under volume growth, so your engineering team spends less time firefighting incidents and more time on product-facing data work.
content.social_proof: For one logistics platform, we improved forecast model accuracy from 26% to 75%, delivering a 15% average reduction in cost per consignment and a fully no-touch supply fulfillment process — the kind of outcome that comes from fixing the data layer first.
content.cta: Would a focused 20-minute call next week make sense to explore whether there's a fit for Personio's current priorities?
content.reasoning: Felix owns Customer Success for DACH SMB accounts at a company in an optimization phase post-Series E — cost efficiency and reliability are top of mind, not growth at all costs. The data_engineering angle is valid because Personio's stack (AWS, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, Kubernetes) is under real volume pressure from 15,000+ customers, and the 9.6% headcount growth signal means data volumes are still climbing even as hiring slows. The logistics social proof is chosen because it demonstrates concrete cost reduction from improved data accuracy — directly resonant with a cost-optimization narrative. The hook avoids generic pitches by anchoring on Personio's specific consolidation context rather than a hypergrowth story.
content.body:
Hi Felix Schmidt,

I'm Prashant Biswas from Ganit. We are a full-stack Data & AI company, recognized by Everest, Forrester, and Analytics India.

With your team in Berlin managing data pipelines for 15,000+ SMB customers across 6 countries and headcount up 9.6% in the last 12 months, the pressure on your AWS and PostgreSQL infrastructure to hold freshness SLAs without creeping warehouse costs is a real constraint — especially in a consolidation phase where every euro of infrastructure spend is under scrutiny.

We help SaaS platforms at your scale reduce pipeline toil and keep data costs flat under volume growth, so your engineering team spends less time firefighting incidents and more time on product-facing data work.

For one logistics platform, we improved forecast model accuracy from 26% to 75%, delivering a 15% average reduction in cost per consignment and a fully no-touch supply fulfillment process — the kind of outcome that comes from fixing the data layer first.

Would a focused 20-minute call next week make sense to explore whether there's a fit for Personio's current priorities?

With regards,
Ganit team
